dedupe_keys.name: office francais de la biodiversite drinking water datasets

description: Office Français de la Biodiversité: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office Français de la Biodiversité. Coverage: Office Français de la Biodiversité. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Services publics d'eau potable - description et indicateurs de perform; Services publics d'eau potable - composition communale des services; Xème PROGRAMME : ZONAGE ENJEU EAU POTABLE. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
